panel_open_on_start.title: Open the Construct panel on start
panel_open_on_start.description: Open the docked Construct panel when a session starts (on by default); /construct opens it any time and /construct close closes it

command_guard_asks.title: Ask before destructive commands
command_guard_asks.description: Let command-guard ask before destructive commands (rm -rf, force push, reset --hard, and the rest); off by default. Denies of verifier bypasses such as git commit --no-verify always apply

inline_edit_max_lines.title: Inline edit limit (lines)
inline_edit_max_lines.description: Let the main thread edit repository files directly when one Write, Edit, MultiEdit, or NotebookEdit call changes at most this many lines; surface-guard sends bigger changes to construct:worker. 0 restores the old rule: the main thread writes only odd/tasks/

slice_lines.title: Commit slice budget (lines)
slice_lines.description: Authored changed lines on a feature branch (against the default branch) after which delivery-signals asks you to apply the delivery strategy; a target, not a cap. Whole number of 1 or more, otherwise the default applies
